problem: Generic Portal V2 status badges/event counts can show UNVERIFIED or NOT_LIVE as green, RED/AMBER as neutral, despite original 15-loop truth.
rootCause: Positive substring matching precedes negative-evidence handling; direct RED/AMBER tokens absent.
fix: Single read-only source-backed status projection; priority red/critical/blocked -> amber/evidence due -> green verified and no positive matches for negated statuses.
prevention: A status cannot look green unless positive semantics survive negative/evidence-missing guards. Regression test negative and mixed meanings; original 15-loop raw source remains authority.
effect: UI truth only; neither provider publication nor realized revenue can be inferred from a badge.
